(subject.He/She) carefully swims to the surface and hauls it ashore. Turns out, it's full of exotic ingredients, the likes of which (subject) has never seen before! Your village gains (award) food.

(subject.He/She) stares wide-eyed in horror as the air rises to the surface in a large bubble before exploding in a deafening blast. (subject) forgets (subject.his/her) training and starts clawing through the water like a drowning animal.
